note: Preferences, not an allowlist. Both Claude and OpenAI are first-class because the team runs Claude Code and Codex. Model ids are the ones current when this file was written (2026-09-16); verify against the provider's list before recording one in generation.json, and record the id actually used, never the alias.

main.purpose: Interviews the PM, plans the composition, generates React and SCSS.

researcher.purpose: Operates the browser on competitor products and audits the RD catalogue; returns only the brief.

validator.purpose: Runs prototype:check:fast and returns the compressed failure list. Cheapest capable model.

reviewer.purpose: Scores the intake rubric or the visual rubric and returns schema-valid JSON. Must not be the builder model.

pairings.condition: reviewer model id differs from builder model id
